    BEGIN { ch = "preamble"; fence = 0; com = 0 }
    {
      line = $0
      if (com) { if (index(line, "-->")) com = 0; print line; next }
      if (!fence && line ~ /^[ \t]*<!--/) { rest = substr(line, index(line, "<!--") + 4); if (!index(rest, "-->")) com = 1; print line; next }
      if (line ~ /^[ \t]*```/) { fence = !fence; print line; next }
      if (!fence && line ~ /^## [0-9]+\.[0-9]+[ \t]/) { split(line, w, /[ \t]+/); ch = w[2] }
      if (!fence && index(line, "<<AGENT:") == 1) {
        fn = A "/" ch ".md"; got = 0
        while ((getline l < fn) > 0) { print l; got = 1 }
        close(fn)
        if (!got) print line
        next
      }
      print line
    }' "$f" > "$f.tmp" && mv "$f.tmp" "$f"
done
"]}

# fill <payload> <answers>: replace each `<<AGENT:` line with the answer file of (doc, chapter) — same chapter rule as _Doc
p="$1"; a="$2"
for f in "$p"/0*.md; do
  n=$(basename "$f" .md)
  awk -v A="$a/$n" '
    BEGIN { ch = "preamble"; fence = 0; com = 0 }
    {
      line = $0
      if (com) { if (index(line, "-->")) com = 0; print line; next }
      if (!fence && line ~ /^[ \t]*<!--/) { rest = substr(line, index(line, "<!--") + 4); if (!index(rest, "-->")) com = 1; print line; next }
      if (line ~ /^[ \t]*```/) { fence = !fence; print line; next }
      if (!fence && line ~ /^## [0-9]+\.[0-9]+[ \t]/) { split(line, w, /[ \t]+/); ch = w[2] }
      if (!fence && index(line, "<<AGENT:") == 1) {
        fn = A "/" ch ".md"; got = 0
        while ((getline l < fn) > 0) { print l; got = 1 }
        close(fn)
        if (!got) print line
        next
      }
      print line
    }' "$f" > "$f.tmp" && mv "$f.tmp" "$f"
done
"]}

      if (!fence && line ~ /^## [0-9]+\.[0-9]+[ \t]/) { split(line, w, /[ \t]+/); ch = w[2] }
      if (!fence && index(line, "<<AGENT:") == 1) {
        fn = A "/" ch ".md"; got = 0
        while ((getline l < fn) > 0) { print l; got = 1 }
        close(fn)
        if (!got) print line
        next
      }
      print line
    }' "$f" > "$f.tmp" && mv "$f.tmp" "$f"
done
"]}

    }' "$f" > "$f.tmp" && mv "$f.tmp" "$f"

      if (!fence && index(line, "<<AGENT:") == 1) {
        fn = A "/" ch ".md"; got = 0
        while ((getline l < fn) > 0) { print l; got = 1 }
        close(fn)
        if (!got) print line
        next
      }
      print line
    }' "$f" > "$f.tmp" && mv "$f.tmp" "$f"
done
